social_security.summary: Nevada has no personal income tax, so Social Security benefits are not taxed by the state.

sources.quote: The State of Nevada does not impose a state income tax on individuals or participate in the administration of Federal Income Tax.

notes: Nevada levies no individual income tax (the state constitution, Art. 10 sec. 1, bars a tax on wages or personal income; that text is not in the statute index here, so no statute source is given). The Commerce Tax applies only to businesses with Nevada gross revenue over $4 million and does not reach retirement income.
